facts.text: The hotel sits on the waterfront directly across from New York City, steps from the PATH and NY Waterway Ferry.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the waterfront directly across from New York City, our Hoboken waterfront hotel is steps from the PATH and NY Waterway Ferry, enabling you to access Manhattan with ease.

facts.text: Manhattan is one stop away by train or ferry.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy proximity to Manhattan – just one stop away via train or ferry

facts.text: Over 80% of rooms have river-facing balconies.
facts.excerpt: With over 80% of rooms featuring river-facing balconies

facts.text: Guest rooms offer views of the Hudson River, the waterfront and the NYC skyline.
facts.excerpt: Take in the vistas of the Hudson River and waterfront from our hotel rooms with NYC skyline views.

facts.text: Penthouse I has two bedrooms, a powder room and a kitchenette opening into a living area.
facts.excerpt: Two bedrooms, a chic powder room, and a sleek kitchenette open into a vibrant living area designed for mixing, mingling, and making memories.

facts.text: Penthouse II has an entertainment zone with a vinyl record player.
facts.excerpt: The entertainment zone amps up the mood with a chrome credenza, yellow lacquered details, and a vinyl record player spinning the vibe.

facts.text: A one-bedroom suite has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony with New York skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Sunlight pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, leading you to a private balcony where the New York skyline stretches endlessly across the horizon.

facts.text: Woodhouse Day Spa is on site.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Woodhouse Day Spa is located on-site at W Hoboken.

facts.text: Spa guests are greeted with a robe and reflexology sandals.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel spa in Hoboken greets you with a luxurious robe and reflexology sandals

facts.text: The gym has Hudson River and Manhattan skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Sweat it out on Floor 2A in our 1520 sq-foot gym with Hudson River and Manhattan skyline views.

facts.text: Halifax is a waterfront restaurant with patio dining overlooking the city skyline and the Hudson River.
facts.excerpt: Halifax is a waterfront restaurant in Hoboken, the restaurant offers outdoor dining on our patio with stunning views of the city skyline and the Hudson River.

facts.text: Sushi by Bou offers a 12-course omakase tasting menu by an Edomae-style sushi chef.
facts.excerpt: This Hoboken omakase dining experience features a 12-course tasting menu crafted by an Edomae-style sushi chef using premium Japanese fish

facts.text: The Living Room Bar hosts live DJs.
facts.excerpt: Whether you're vibing with live DJs in our Living Room Bar

facts.excerpt: enjoy special amenities like the W pet bed, toys, water bowl and treats.

facts.excerpt: lush parks and walkways including Pier A Park, Sinatra Park, and nearby Liberty State Park.

facts.excerpt: Where sweeping skyline views converge with modern maritime aesthetic

facts.excerpt: Sink into our signature W bed with pillow-top mattress, 350-thread-count sheets and goose down comforter.
